ownerType.description: Type that first defines the table (e.g. defines an arry/mapp field using the table).

tableType.description: Type of the table itself (e.g. root, mapp, etc.)

collectionField.description: Collection field that uses the table.  Will be null for non-collection tables.

columns.description: All of the columns defined in the table.

primaryKey.description: The primary key index defined on the table.

foreignKeys.description: Foreign keys defined on the table.

foreignKeyRefs.description: Foreign keys defined on other tables that refer to this tables primary key

title: Table returned in {@link SqlSchema.allTables} and {@link SqlSchema.allExtensionTables}.
name: SqlTable
